title: Microwave display
hints: With two `int`s, `/` throws away the remainder: `125 / 60` is `2`. And `%` gives you exactly the part that was thrown away: `125 % 60` is `5`.
Split the time into whole minutes (`seconds / 60`) and leftover seconds (`seconds % 60`). Then shift the minutes two digits to the left by multiplying them by 100.
`int minutes = seconds / 60; int rest = seconds % 60; return minutes * 100 + rest;`
